notes: The finisher's x-ray is gone: finishers now land with a BLACK FLASH. The world snaps to a negative, drops into red and black, and black lightning with a red glow tears out of the point of impact, flickering, then an inverted frame and a red flash. New rebirth unlocks: Rebirth 1 unlocks your finisher, Rebirth 2 gives your finisher the Black Flash, Rebirth 3 gives your heavy attacks their own small, quick impact frame on a clean hit. (Maxing your stats still earns the evolved ★ and gold aura.)
